summary: Mesoblast filed a Form 6-K furnishing its FY2026 Annual Report, Notice of Annual General Meeting, and Appendix 4G corporate governance statement, each lodged with the ASX on October 12, 2026. The annual report highlights first full-year commercialization of FDA-approved Ryoncil, with US$115 million net product sales and US$120 million total revenue versus US$17 million in FY2025, plus roughly US$104 million gross profit. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is disclosed; these are routine shareholder-meeting and reporting materials, not a special situation. What to watch: pipeline approvals and cash runway, not deal terms.
